central_question: Does a finalized high EPU-to-realized-volatility disconnect combined with low realized volatility predict a profitable and relatively superior US500 09:30..16:00 ET LONG cash-session path five weeks later after doubled FPMarkets spread cost?
economic_hypothesis: The paper's uncertainty compensation should be strongest when uncertainty is high relative to volatility while volatility itself is low. If this premium transfers to an executable CFD cash-session sleeve, HIGH_D_LOW_V must be positive across the initial and all three confirmation periods, beat low-disconnect and unconditional controls on per-day and risk-adjusted economics, and not reverse in June-July 2026.

literature_anchor.title: When Uncertainty and Volatility Are Disconnected: Implications for Asset Pricing and Portfolio Performance
literature_anchor.publisher: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
frozen_facts: The paper constructs weekly uncertainty as a five-trading-day mean of the daily news-based U.S. EPU index.
Weekly realized volatility is derived from intraday S&P 500 returns, and disconnect is uncertainty divided by realized volatility, normalized to a mean of one.
Discrete high/low states use the mean plus one-half standard deviation for volatility and disconnect.
High-disconnect/low-volatility states have the strongest subsequent risk-adjusted stock excess return for most horizons from one through twelve weeks.
The paper explicitly distinguishes its in-sample portfolio comparison from its later out-of-sample forecast exercise.
literature_anchor.translation_limit: This unit does not claim exact CRSP or five-minute replication. It tests a predeclared broker-M15, cash-session-only, no-carry transfer with a causal expanding threshold and a five-week data-finalization lag.

premetric_design_correction.fault: The first predictor-only implementation classified EPU and volatility separately.
premetric_design_correction.correction: Before any target return or economic field was calculated, classification was corrected to the paper's disconnect = EPU / realized-volatility ratio plus volatility state.

fixed_state_rule.complete_source_week: Exactly five Monday-Friday US500 cash sessions, each containing 26 M15 bars from 09:30 through 15:45 ET.
fixed_state_rule.weekly_uncertainty: Mean daily_policy_index on the five source-session dates.
fixed_state_rule.weekly_realized_volatility: Square root of the sum of squared 26-bar cash-session log returns over the five sessions.
fixed_state_rule.disconnect: weekly_uncertainty / weekly_realized_volatility; multiplying every ratio by a common normalization cannot change its standardized threshold and is omitted.
fixed_state_rule.thresholds: For the current source week, compare disconnect and volatility with their respective mean plus 0.5 sample standard deviation over all strictly prior complete source weeks.
fixed_state_rule.warmup: Exactly 26 complete source weeks before the first state.
fixed_state_rule.primary_state: HIGH_D_LOW_V: disconnect strictly above its threshold and volatility at or below its threshold.
fixed_state_rule.target_lag: target week Monday = source week Monday + 5 calendar weeks
fixed_state_rule.minimum_source_age_at_target: 31 calendar days from source Friday to target Monday

fixed_trade_rule.eligible_target: Every complete 09:30..16:00 ET cash session inside a classified target week and a declared period.
fixed_trade_rule.exit: 15:45 ET M15 close representing the 16:00 ET boundary
fixed_trade_rule.observed: Executable entry ask to exit bid; algebraically gross less half of entry-plus-exit spread burden.
fixed_trade_rule.stressed: Gross less the full entry-plus-exit spread burden; binding doubled-cost measure.
fixed_trade_rule.commission_swap_financing: Zero because every position closes inside one cash session.
fixed_trade_rule.drawdown: Closed-balance cumulative daily path; proxy drawdown cannot prove native floating-equity DD.

premetric_feasibility.scope: Only immutable bytes/schema, complete cash-session geometry, source-week EPU/realized-volatility predictors, disconnect thresholds, causal target-week mappings and state counts were opened.
